x.text: So exciting to finally see the agenda come together! Lots of strong talks and juicy research topics in this lineup. Can’t wait to see them on stage 🔥

linkedin.text: Day Zero Year 1 was a success! It was such an honor to present on the keynote stage this Monday at CrowdStrike’s first Day Zero Threat Research Summit. I really enjoyed the talks, the conversations, and the many people I had the chance to meet throughout the conference.

bluesky.text: Great to see my research with @julianferdinand.bsky.social covered by @raphae.li on @reuters.com! Cyber espionage isn't limited to major cyber powers. Our findings offer an interesting glimpse into Kazakhstan-linked activity targeting Russia and the wider CIS region. www.reuters.com/legal/litiga...
